title: Why Origen examined heretics and philosophers
english: Since I was devoted to the word, and news about us was spreading, sometimes heretics came to me, and sometimes those from Greek learning, especially those in philosophy. So it seemed good to examine both the doctrines of the heretics and the things [...]

orientation: Origen is narrating in the first person how, as his reputation spread, both heretics and people trained in Greek learning came to him, which led him to decide to examine their teachings.

title: Heraclas's philosophical training and continuing practice
english: Heraclas had already persevered with him for five years before I began to hear those lectures. Because of this, Heraclas had earlier taken off the common clothing he was wearing and put on the philosopher's garb, which he keeps to this day, and he does not cease studying the books of the Greeks to the best of his ability.
